# Anthropic Administrator

The Anthropic Admin API allows programmatic management of organizational resources, including members, workspaces, and API keys.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/anthropic-administrator/.

## Actions

- **Create Message**: Create a new message completion.
- **Get Model**: Retrieve details of a specific model by its id.
- **List models**: List available models.
- **Prompt Caching**: Cache and reuse prompt content to reduce costs and latency.
